topic.title: What ₹8,000 a month put away for retirement becomes in 30 years

title: Your ₹8,000 monthly retirement habit: worth how much?
description: Put ₹8,000 away every month for 30 years at an assumed 10% a year. Can you pick the right answer before the countdown ends? Returns are assumptions, not assured. Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
